**Finding: COMPLIANT (preferred level) — no redline proposed.**

- **Section 3.19 "Exclusivity Commitment of SFJ"** (p0369–p0374) is the only exclusivity covenant, and it runs against SFJ and its Affiliates during the Exclusive Period (1.1.68). It restrains the counterparty and benefits us, so it is not flagged.
- **No PB-side non-compete or field-of-use restriction exists.** Searches for competing-product, exclusivity, field-of-use and "PB shall not" restraints returned only financing/collateral covenants in Article 7.5.
- **Section 7.5.5 (Licensing Transactions)** is a consent covenant protecting SFJ's funded royalty stream, not a business restraint: PB may freely enter any Excluded Licensing Transaction (including licensing its ELP technology, PB1046/PB1023), and consent may be withheld only on a reasoned "Material Impact" determination subject to expedited arbitration. 7.5.6 and 7.5.7 are royalty-stream and negative-pledge covenants.
- **Section 15.15** reserves to PB all rights not expressly granted to SFJ.
